target_transformation.notes: Inverse transform logic is correct, but untuned log1p models extrapolate wildly, leading to massive RMSE due to exponential amplification.

chronological_split.notes: December holdout is correctly isolated and untouched during the grid search.

preprocessing_leakage.notes: Imputers and encoders are strictly fitted on the train split only.

feature_group_a.notes: Exogenous features only. No historical features included.

feature_group_b.notes: Valid for operational one-step-ahead forecasting where recent consumption is observed. Cannot be directly applied to blind batch test sets.

historical_leakage.notes: shift(1) correctly applied before rolling aggregations. Current target is strictly excluded.

building_sampling.notes: Deterministic hash guarantees the same 23-building sample across all runs, preserving chronological integrity.

model_comparability.notes: All models receive semantically equivalent features with safe, model-specific encodings.

metrics.notes: Metrics calculated on the original raw energy scale. Negative predictions are clipped to the minimum observed target.

result_consistency.notes: 24 experiments completed. LightGBM (log1p, GroupB) achieved lowest MAE. CatBoost (raw, GroupB) achieved highest R2.

computational_validity.notes: Lightweight, untuned parameters correctly configured for pilot verification.

lightgbm_warnings.notes: Normal behavior. Caused by tree growth reaching limits on small pilot data subsets.
